summary.headline: Preface to Italian Codices
summary.text: The preface explains the completion of the fourth volume covering Italian astrological codices beyond the Roman ones, credits scholars for cataloguing the Florentine, Venetian, Milanese, Neapolitan, Messanese, Bolognese, Modenese, Turinese, Parmesan, and Bergamasque collections, and acknowledges the compilation of the general index and publication of fragmentary materials.
